article.headline: Dartmouth 80, Colgate 63
article.story: HANOVER, N.H. -- Clive Weeden had 14 points and 12 rebounds to lead six Dartmouth players in double figures in an 80-63 victory over Colgate on Saturday. David Rufful, R.J. Griffin, Gediminas Bertasius and Ronnie Dixon added 11 points each for the Big Green (2-4), who had lost two consecutive games. Dartmouth used an 18-6 second-half run to push its 40-37 lead to 58-43 on Jabari Trotter's jumper with 7:44 remaining. Colgate cut the margin to 63-55 on Chad Johnson's free throw with 3:41 remaining, but Dartmouth scored the next nine points for a 72-55 advantage with 1:07 to play. Trotter finished with 10 points for Dartmouth, which outrebounded the Raiders 42-32. Brothers Tyler Melville (Dartmouth) and Sterling Melville (Colgate) scored two points each. Pat Moore and Mitch Rolls scored 14 points each to lead Colgate (0-5). John Brandenburg and Mike Venezia added 10 points each.
